findingDetails.title: The advisor README calls the companion policy run/start/ask and omits the child form the renderer prints
findingDetails.claim: The README says the companion carries run, start or ask, but a dispatched child prints parent-named only for start, ask and writing run, as the pinned test at doctor-brief-render.vitest.ts:84 shows.
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n -F 'where the policy is run, start or ask' .skilled/skills/system-skill-advisor/README.md prints line 121; render.ts:216 returns PARENT_NAMED_POLICY; doctor-brief-render.vitest.ts:76-84 pins both the read-only run and the parent-named child form.

spec_code.notes: phase 021 companion requirement implemented; advisor README states a narrower policy set than the child branch prints; iteration 1 head-command gap remains

checklist_evidence.notes: phase 021 tasks read as change history

agent_cross_runtime.notes: child rule matches spec-gate core across the matrix; renderer shared by all six runtimes

feature_catalog_code.notes: advisor-recommend.md top-only sentence is the open phase 025 item; plugin top-only request not yet described
